description: This file defines an automated test case class 'IsolatedTestCase' using JUnit and Spring testing framework, containing multiple test methods for creating, retrieving, and manipulating products, categories, manufacturers, users, and configuration modules for the SalesManager e-commerce system. It serves as a comprehensive test suite for core business logic and data setup in the project.

classes.name: IsolatedTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test class that contains various test methods to validate core functionalities like product creation, retrieval, category management, user permissions, and configuration module handling within the SalesManager e-commerce platform.

methods.name: test1CreateReferences
methods.description: Initializes the database with test data by calling the populate method of InitializationDatabase.

methods.name: testSearchProduct
methods.description: Performs a search for products based on predefined criteria such as category IDs and availability status, printing 'done' after execution.

methods.name: testGetMerchant
methods.description: Retrieves the default merchant store and prints 'done'.

methods.name: testCreateProductWithImage
methods.description: Creates and associates an image with a product, including setting descriptions in different languages.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates and saves a new product with associated description, image, availability, and price details.

methods.name: test2CreateProducts
methods.description: Creates multiple categories, manufacturers, and products with various attributes, descriptions, and hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: test3CreateUser
methods.description: Creates user groups and permissions, associating them accordingly.

methods.name: testGetProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID and logs its descriptions.

methods.name: testGetProducts
methods.description: Fetches products within a category for a specific locale and logs their IDs.

methods.name: testGetProductsByCategories
methods.description: Deletes a category and logs completion.

methods.name: testCategory
methods.description: Creates a hierarchy of categories with multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: testGetModules
methods.description: Fetches and prints available shipping integration modules.

methods.name: testCreateModules
methods.description: Creates a set of module configurations for third-party services like Canada Post and USPS, serializes/deserializes configurations, and outputs the JSON.

methods.name: testCreateManufacturer
methods.description: Creates languages, currencies, countries, a merchant store, manufacturers, and products with descriptions, prices, and availabilities.

methods.name: testStoreRandomProducts
methods.description: Generates multiple random products for load testing.
